newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron in China pager business deal.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron in China pager business deal.

text.p: Electronics group Goldtron Ltd said on Monday it had entered into a license contract with Chinese parties for the transfer of pager design and manufacturing technology.

It would also supply pager kits to the Chinese parties for the manufacture of "Eastcom" brand pagers, a Goldtron statement said. The contract for pager kits is estimated at US$20 million for the first 12 months of the license.

The non-exclusive, royalty-bearing, five-year license contract was made with Hangzhou Communications Company Ltd (HCCL). HCCL is under the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications and the Zhejiang province.
Goldtron said the license will be effective upon approval from China's Ministry of Foreign Economic Relations and Trade.
Eastcom is owned by a subsidiary of HCCL, Eastern Communications Co Ltd, which manufactures, sells and services cellular mobile telecommunications products in China.
Goldtron said the license and the supply of paper kits are expected to contribute positively to the company's earnings for the financial year ending December 31 1997.
